notes: Only the `עַל` of *overfloweth all its banks* is unrepresented; the ASV promotes its object to a direct object and leaves the relation unstated (rule 40).

The first `נֹשְׂאֵי` is substantival with no antecedent and takes the supplied *they that* under rule 46, headed on *bare*; the second modifies the explicit *priests* and takes its relative under rule 41.
